name: Sandboxed Tools
description: OS-level sandboxed Bash / Edit / Write / text_editor tools (ADR-0028). When a session enables sandbox mode the SDK builtins are replaced by these, which route through the platform sandbox backend (bwrap / sandbox-exec) via the sandbox_exec command.
author: cognia-next

browser.hint: OS sandbox backends (bwrap / sandbox-exec) run in the Tauri desktop shell — sandboxed exec is unavailable in the browser.
